## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change made.

## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant tests added or updated
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --all-targets --all-features` passes
- [ ] Security claims state their assumptions and bounds
- [ ] No secrets or unnecessary proprietary snippets are included

## Risk and limitations

Document behavior changes, compatibility concerns, and anything left
inconclusive.
